dedupe_keys.name: bristol flourish its g5 dsrc and ism communications traces

description: This collection records ITS-G5 communications between two vehicle-mounted units and four roadside units on the FLOURISH test track in central Bristol. University of Bristol researchers run eight two-hour sessions over four days, testing licensed DSRC and unlicensed 2.4–2.5 and 5.725–5.875 gigahertz bands. The repository records transmitted and received cooperative-awareness messages, signal strength and receiver location, and lists raw and processed date-organised folders. The article identifies PCAP, CSV and MATLAB tables. Access is free under the Non-Commercial Government Licence for public sector information. Coverage is this urban track and selected sessions; exact dates were not interpreted solely from folder names. A stated limitation restricts reuse to packet-delivery and signal-strength relationships, not signal-propagation modelling. Modellers could calibrate simplified physical-layer packet-delivery responses in full-stack vehicular simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related simulator, without verified replay. No trace, MATLAB table or archive was downloaded or executed.
